title: Grateful Dead Live at Pittsburgh Civic Arena on 1973-09-24
lineage: Tascam DA-20mkII > SBLive! (48-44.1) > WAV > MKW Audio Compression Tool

ai_review.summary: Excellent old‑soundboard recording with a young, high‑energy band and standout performances of China Doll and Greatest Story Ever Told.
ai_review.review: The three fan reviews are uniformly enthusiastic, praising the warm, “yummy” Jerry Garcia tone and the classic soundboard source. The set list is highlighted as terrific, with special love for a standalone "China Doll" and a fine rendition of "Greatest Story Ever Told" from 1973. No technical flaws are mentioned, making this both a musically and sonically satisfying capture.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give high marks (4‑5 stars) and comment positively on both performance and sound quality; the weighting of a strong show and excellent soundboard yields a rating near 4.6.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note the classic, warm sound of an old soundboard with no reported drop‑outs or muddiness; the capture is clear and balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Terrific set list praised for its flow and variety, showcasing a youthful band at peak energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as “yummy sounding” with a great tone; highlighted throughout the show.
